context: A teacher and student discuss a paper
purpose: Teach: 儀礼/貫く/浮き彫り/造船/応じる/騙し/辞退/モニタリング

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、儀礼研究、丁寧でしたね。
lines.en: Your paper on ceremonial research was quite meticulous.
lines.style: Warm, steady approval. Lean forward slightly. Clear-eyed assessment—not flattery, just recognition. Measured pace, landing on 'meticulous' with quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。基本姿勢を貫く編集、難しかったです。
lines.en: Yes. It was really difficult to maintain that foundational approach throughout the editing.
lines.style: Careful, almost self-conscious. Modest but genuine. Slight upward inflection at the end—inviting her to correct him if he's being too hard on himself. Deliberate, not rushed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地域社会の課題が浮き彫りになる章、優れていますね。
lines.en: That chapter where you surface the community's underlying issues—that's excellent work.
lines.style: Genuine interest, leaning in. Vocal lightness on 'excellent'—not performative praise but authentic recognition. Pace slows slightly to let it land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 造船業の衰退、地域経済との接続、論じました。
lines.en: I worked through the shipbuilding industry's decline and how it connects to the local economy.
lines.style: Straightforward, matter-of-fact. No apology in the tone. Solid, grounded delivery—he's naming what he did without hedging. Light emphasis on the structural work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 証言に応じる被害者、本心を引き出せましたか。
lines.en: Were you able to draw out what the victims who gave testimony were really thinking?
lines.style: Thoughtful, probing gently. Not interrogative—exploratory. Slight pause before 'really thinking,' as if considering the weight of that question. Warm curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 過去の騙し事例、参考文献に多数加えました。
lines.en: I referenced quite a few case studies of past deception to ground the analysis.
lines.style: Methodical explanation. Slight defensive undertone—he's showing his work, making sure she sees the rigor. Calm but not casual. Even pacing, no rush.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 登壇を辞退した識者、別途モニタリング論文、紹介できますよ。
lines.en: There's an expert who declined to participate, but I can point you toward a separate monitoring paper that might be useful.
lines.style: Practical, helpful offer. Tone shifts toward facilitation—she's moving from assessment to collaboration. Even, assured delivery. Slight warmth at the close.
